LESSON: READING ALOUD: FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.6: Reading Aloud: Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud: Fluency, part of Reading in Grade 6 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to read correctly? 2. How does reading speed enhance fluency?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly to identify school property from a digital device,

2. read sentences related to the theme aloud,

3. team up to peer assess each other’s reading for correct pronunciation and reading speed,

4. compete in reading words with nunations (tanween) in pairs,

5. collaborate to play a language game involving reading the same sentences aloud at various speeds,

6. work jointly to identify the best reading speed from the speeds used. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly to identify school property from a digital device,
2. read sentences related to the theme aloud,
3. team up to peer assess each other’s reading for correct pronunciation and reading speed,
4. compete in reading words with nunations (tanween) in pairs,
5. collaborate to play a language game involving reading the same sentences aloud at various speeds,
6. work jointly to identify the best reading speed from the speeds used. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud: Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with technology when identifying school property from a digital

device.
